description: The one full 1,000-item live run against DigitalOcean Serverless Inference required by instructions.md. Recorded verbatim from GET /job/{id}/status at job completion.

cost_comparison.readme_generic_estimate_basis: README/docs/scaling.md cost table's generic ~150 input / ~200 output tokens-per-prompt assumption, applied uniformly across every catalog model for comparability
cost_comparison.model_selection_measured_estimate_basis: docs/model-selection.md's own live measurement against a single test prompt: 15 prompt tokens + 94 completion tokens for mistral-3-14B, projected to 1,000 items
cost_comparison.why_lower_than_readme_generic: mistral-3-14B's real chat-template overhead is far below the README's generic ~150-token assumption (observed ~15.3 avg prompt tokens/item here vs. the assumption's 150).
cost_comparison.why_lower_than_model_selection_estimate: this 1,000-item run averaged ~76.6 output tokens/item vs. the single-sample 94 completion tokens docs/model-selection.md measured -- both well under the 128 max_tokens cap (no truncation), but averaging many prompts pulled the mean down from that one sample.

notable_observation.summary: 11 real 429s occurred with no deliberate overshoot -- default concurrency (4), configured at the true 120 RPM account quota.
notable_observation.cause: AdaptiveController.max_rate = rate_rps * 1.5 = 3.0 rps against a true quota of 2.0 rps. The AIMD additive-increase phase (+0.5 rps per 50 consecutive successes) climbs the paced rate up toward that 3.0 rps ceiling over a long-enough run, overshoots the real 2.0 rps limit, gets throttled back down to roughly 1.7-2.3 rps, and climbs again -- classic AIMD hunting around an unknown-to-the-controller true limit, observed live, not engineered for this run.
notable_observation.outcome: All 11 throttled requests retried successfully; conservation held (succeeded + failed == ingested throughout). See docs/decisions.md's "AIMD headroom probing vs. a rate ceiling matched exactly to the configured quota" entry for the tradeoff this represents.
